rows.reason: Sampling1D (the selected common sampler) implements temperature/top-k/top-p only. The pinned plugin routes requests with presence, frequency, or repetition penalties to vLLM's canonical host sampler (model_runner._can_sample_on_device), so those requests leave the traced device path and run slower; tests/tt/test_tt_penalties.py passes through that route.

The device RNG is per-row and positional; a seeded request that moves rows under scheduler compaction cannot reproduce its stream. The pinned plugin routes explicitly seeded requests to the host sampler; unseeded and greedy requests stay on device.

rows.evidence: model_capabilities['max_device_top_k'] = 32 (Sampling1D max_top_k=32, one candidate tile per user). The sampler draws only from the first 32 sorted candidates whatever k is passed (doc/optimized_vllm/sampler_probe/sampling1d_topk_probe.json: k=64 and k=32 give identical draws, maximum sampled rank 31), so 64 was a false ceiling that let the op read past the user's row (out-of-vocabulary ids in slot 31, readiness_vllm/P150_prefill_features/invalid_token_scan_topk64.json). Stochastic requests above 32 use the host sampler by the pinned plugin's routing. The model's generation_config.json default top_k is 64, so the server is launched with --override-generation-config {"top_k":32} (proposed served default, pending operator acceptance); without it every default-recipe sampled request is host-sampled at 97 ms per token (readiness_vllm/P150_prefill_features/default_recipe_latency_ceiling32_no_override.json).

readiness_vllm/P150_prefill_features/sampling_tests.log (tests/tt/test_seeding_and_variety.py, test_request_isolation.py) on the device sampler with the served top_k 32 default (readiness_vllm/P150_prefill_features/invalid_token_scan_final4.json sampling_modes). Stochastic requests that name top_k in 33..64 are routed to the plugin host sampler (97 ms per token, readiness_vllm/P150_prefill_features/default_recipe_latency_ceiling32_no_override.json); see the max_device_top_k row.
